title: Olympia Banquet Hall

services.desc: Olympia Banquet Hall is a great place to host your next corporate event - from retirement parties to Holiday parties. Our experienced team members will guide you throughout the entire planning process. Our private venue provides a tone of professionalism and class to your corporate event. Olympia can comfortably accommodate around 400 guests. Moreover, our banquet hall is just a few miles away from Los Angeles area airports, including LAX and Van Nuys Airport.
